finding.optimizer_collision_sample_rule: step = trajectory_duration / (endpoint_displacement / map_resolution); sample from active start while t < tmp*2/3
finding.safety_window: first two-thirds of the spline, matching the existing FSM collision monitor window
finding.result: The optimizer adaptive samples miss the inflation-mask intervals found by 10 ms samples when replayed against the paired snapshots.

validation.scope: Static replay of serialized B-splines against same-start-time service snapshots; no planner rebuild or runtime intervention.

limitations: Occupancy snapshots were captured after spline receipt; they do not prove byte-identical planner occupancy at optimization time.
The inflated mask is the EGO axis-aligned inflation cube; a hit is not a direct physical collision measurement.
No execution, vehicle tracking, ground truth, or PX4 evidence is included.
Global map known coverage in #316 was below 0.62 percent.
decision: Create an isolated candidate for fixed 10 ms checks over the existing first-two-thirds publishable window. Keep it out of canonical dependencies until runtime behavior and broader map/safety evidence are reviewed.
